messages:
maya: heads up — onboarding q8_2-llama run shows ~3% absolute drop vs float on our standard L2 holdout when run through the eval CI. looks like this only appears after promptset rotation. reproducer and snippets below.

maya: runner commit: a3b9d4f, ci job: pipeline/4821, seed=42, model=q8_2-llama-v1

maya: config snippet:
```yaml
promptset_rotation:
  enabled: true
  mode: cohort_anchor
  anchor_field: cohort_id
  seed: ${EVAL_SEED}
```

sam: can you paste the minimal repro script? also does the quant runner zero-init KV cache between requests?

maya: minimal repro (local):
```python
# repro: prompt rotation order preserved across shards
prompts = load_prompts('prompts.json')
prompts = sorted(prompts, key=lambda p: p['cohort_id'])  # <-- stable sort used in loader
shards = split(prompts, n_shards=8)
# when rotate happens we map shard->cohort by position, not fingerprint
```

jord: This rings a bell. We had a stable-sort in the dataset loader that kept insertion order during rotation. When the rotation map uses index positions to anchor cohorts, the same cohort can end up mapped to different prompts depending on pre-sort order. That creates subtle holdout bleed and non-determinism.

leo: also note: our rotation cron sets EVAL_SEED=$CI_PIPELINE_ID in staging, which makes seed vary between reruns. combine that with the stable-sort and you get flaky per-run permutations. we should derive seed = hash(promptset_name, commit) instead.

sam: quick local patch to show the issue:
```python
import random
def load(prompts, seed):
    random.seed(seed)
    random.shuffle(prompts)  # order matters
    return prompts

# stable-sort kept old order, shuffle exposes the mapping mismatch
```

maya: good catch. I'll open a patch to: 1) ensure loader uses a deterministic permutation (hash-based) instead of CI-timestamp-derived seed; 2) add an assertion in the runner that per-shard fingerprints are disjoint for holdout.

eval-bot: golden-run summary: env=staging, job=pipeline/4821, metric=exact_match, delta=-0.032 (threshold -0.01) -> FAILED. details: https://ci.internal/runs/4821

ci-bot: CI notice: job pipeline/4821 rerun #3 shows flaky failure on test "eval_runner/determinism". Created issue #1256 and linked failing artifacts.

jord: :eyes: I'll take #1256. proposed plan: 1) make promptset rotation deterministic (hash of promptset+commit) 2) add per-shard fingerprint check during dataset build 3) add a small deterministic golden-run in CI that asserts sample_fingerprint sets are stable across reruns.

maya: :thumbsup: timeline? can we get a hotfix into staging today?

sam: pushing patch -> refs/heads/fix/promptset-anchor-17252. will include unit test for shuffle determinism.

leo: :fire: I'll watch the eval dashboard and roll back model variants if any further regression shows up.

maya: thanks team — will monitor next golden-run and follow up in #eng-ml.
